capacity_claim: Not certified for 10k concurrent active users. Not a hyperscale (1B-user) architecture: see docs/CAPACITY_AND_SCALE.md. Requires staging load tests and explicit backend redesign before large-scale claims.

verification.message_history: newest-first cursor pagination, page size 50, incremental Realtime INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
verification.message_commands: text, sticker, image, edit and delete routed through application service; legacy renderer retained
verification.legacy_loader: legacy stable message loader unified with modular paginated timeline
verification.realtime_races: in-flight INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE events reconciled with latest/catch-up reads; subscription epoch separated from request generation
verification.conversation_list: membership-scoped repository and modular list controller; legacy renderer retained
verification.channel_feed: staged initial render; bounded posts/polls; lazy comments; stale channel requests ignored
verification.conversation_projection: modular sorting, unread counts, message preview projection, read cursor writes and Realtime ownership
verification.legacy_retirement: 24 ordered legacy scripts remain; retire only after feature parity and integration coverage
verification.conversation_open: latest-request-only post-open effects; preflight cancellation; legacy opener remains the DOM/rendering compatibility entry point
verification.conversation_navigation: active conversation and reply-target state committed through ConversationNavigationController with latest-request tokens and ID validation
verification.history_pagination: older-page in-flight locks are scoped per conversation; stale responses cannot update the newly active conversation
verification.realtime_subscription_races: subscription request sequence prevents stale channel attachment after asynchronous channel removal
verification.typing_presence: modular TypingPresenceController owns typing broadcast and peer presence status; rim-core skips when __RIM_TYPING_PRESENCE_OWNED
verification.own_presence: OwnPresenceController owns last_seen heartbeat; rim-core startPresence skipped when owned
verification.message_decorations: MessageDecorationsController owns advanced actions, forward labels, attachment chips; legacy 06/18/24 wraps skipped when owned
verification.message_list_renderer: MessageListRenderer owns base message HTML; decorations and receipts remain post-pass
verification.conversation_shell: ConversationShellController owns mobile shell, provisional header, group settings button and group avatar signing
verification.channel_commands: join/leave/moderate/unrestrict via existing RPCs through ChannelCommandService
verification.voice_messages: VoiceMessageController owns record button and send pipeline; rim-core gated
verification.conversation_list_paint: ConversationListController.paintList owns chatList DOM; delegated openConversation
verification.admin_commands: toggleAds + setUserRole via AdminCommandService; list/search helpers available
verification.bugfixes_37: channel settings modal z-index; optimistic send; activity hydrate; favorites unpinned
